preview: Detailed interview experience for an FTE role at Deutsche Bank covering online assessment, technical rounds, professional fitness, and HR round.
content: INTERVIEW EXPERIENCE (FTE) DIPTI KAVATHKAR B. TECH IT Eligibility: ●Branch: CS, IT, EXTC ● B.Tech Undergraduate - 7 CGPA ● No backlogs Hiring Workflow: 1. Coding Round 2. Technical Interview 1 3. Technical Interview 2 4. Professional fitness round 5. HR round Online Coding Assessment : Platform: Hackerearth | Test Duration: 90 mins The online assessment was scheduled on 4th August 2023. The proctored test was held on the HackerEarth platform. There were total 3 questions: 1 question of 20 marks and 2 questions of 50 marks each. 1. Optimal use of two power resources: Two power resources and their initial power capacity were given as input. At every step we have to optimally choose between one of the resources. At every step capacity of chosen resource gets reduced by 2 and that of the unchosen resource increases by 1 so you can only choose a resource with capacity greater than 1. Repeat this until one of the power stations capacity becomes zero. Return the number of steps required if we use the resources optimally. Sample input: 5, 3 Output: 6 It is solved by greedy approach by choosing the greater number at each step I passed 9/10 test cases ( I missed out on one basic condition :) though it was simple so please make sure you read the entire question carefully ) 2. Most similar string for a given query: Given a list of strings and a query string, we have to find the string from the list which is most similar or closest to the given query string. To do so we have to calculate the Levenshtein distance ( minimum number of insert a character/delete character / replace character - operations to be performed on a string to convert the string to the given query). Return the word with lowest Levenshtein distance. If two words have the same Levenshtein distance, then the lexicographically smaller word is the answer. Finding the Levenshtein distance is a well known DP problem - Edit distance I passed all test cases 3. Blacklinks: Given a string array of webpage titles and an integer array of number of blacklinks on the corresponding pages, we have to return the webpage titles in decreasing order of number of blacklinks in them. If two pages contain same number of blacklinks then arrange them in order of their index in the input array. Output will be a list of strings. This can be done by taking a vector of pairs in c++ and sort using a comparator on the given conditions. I passed all the test cases. 40 students were shortlisted for the offline interviews which were held on 9th August 2023 in TPO Technical Interview 1 : The interviewer was friendly and started with general talks like where do I live etc. ➢Tell me about yourself. ➢Show one to many and many to many relationships (Not using ER model) in tables using sample entries in it. And some follow up questions. ➢If a table is empty then what will COUNT * query return - 0 or NULL? ➢Explain ACID Properties. ➢Questions on lists, tuples and dictionaries in python. Write a for loop code in a single line in python. ➢Many trick questions on Linked Lists and Trees which would be lengthy to list down here. Basically he created various scenarios using pointers and asked me if such a scenario is valid or not. ➢Questions on constructors and destructors. ➢Job scheduling techniques in OS ➢Explain various git commands and then a follow up question was: If I was working in a team of 4 on a project which has to be directly deployed to the production after testing and all of them have done their individual part and I have to merge that project, what all things I will check or ensure before merging to avoid conflicts, keeping in mind that the testing will be done on a small data and after deploying it will be subjected to large data. I gave my answers to the best of my knowledge, he added some of his points and gave hints and we had a good discussion on this. ➢Explain your hackathon project and why have we used the mentioned tech stack ➢Explain the recursion tree for printing factorial of a number. ➢The recursion tree of the merge sort algorithm resembles which data structure- Binary tree or binary search tree? I thought about this and answered binary tree. He said it will be both - a binary tree and an ‘Inverse’ Binary Search tree. I politely asked him to explain how it will be inverse BST and he patiently explained to me. ➢Do you have any questions for me? (Always ask questions) The interview lasted for more than an hour. To my surprise he didn’t ask any coding questions but he tested me on data structures and other concepts with some twisted questions. Technical Interview 2 : ➢Introduce yourself. She asked me what was asked in the previous round and accordingly she framed her questions. ➢Explain your personal (MERN) project. (Explain your project using STAR approach ) ➢Then she pointed out one feature and asked me to explain in detail how I implemented it. What more features can I add to the project? ➢What is multer-gridfs storage (based on my project) ➢Some basic questions like: What is Node and Express? What are APIs ? REST APIs? What are synchronous and asynchronous calls? Is Node.js synchronous or asynchronous? ➢What is middleware? Where have I used it in my project? What is Redux? ➢If you have to explain the MERN stack to a complete beginner how would you explain it. She asked me to start right from what are node modules and packages uptill creating and connecting the database. ➢Explain Polymorphism and its types. Write a C++ code to show runtime polymorphism. ➢Write code for the optimized solution to this question and its time complexity: https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/find-first-and-last-positions-of-an-element-in-a-sorted-array/ ➢Write the pseudo code for LRU Cache and dry run. ➢Some questions on Binary search tree ➢Two puzzles: ● https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/weight-heavy-ball/ ● https://byjus.com/question-answer/there-are-three-boxes-one-contains-only-apples-one-contains-only-oranges-and-one-contains/ She didn’t ask me if I have any questions for her but she extended a handshake with a smile which felt really nice. Professional Fitness Round : (The type of questions in this round may differ depending upon the interviewer. For me it was General questions + Internship + situational questions) ➢Tell me about yourself ➢What was your role in the GDSC Cloud computing team ➢Your internship experience and the challenges faced during internship. ➢What are your strengths and weaknesses? What actions have you taken to overcome your weaknesses? Here after all questions were situation based ➢You have completed your training period but immediately after joining you are assigned to a project having a completely new tech stack. You have to learn the tech plus complete the project in 2 weeks. You have a choice not to be a part of that project. What will you do? ➢You are assigned to a project in a team of 3 where the other two are juniors whom you have to teach the technology from base and also complete the project. How will you handle this knowing that you will have more workload as the other two are beginners? ➢You are facing difficulties in a project which can only be solved by one senior person. However he/she is very reserved and doesn’t interact much with juniors. How will you get your work done? ➢You are in a team where everyone except you are very experienced seniors and professionals, you might feel intimidated. How will you overcome this and give your best performance? ➢How will you handle days with extra workload? ➢Any questions for me? The interviewer looked happy with all my answers. *NOTE*: Be optimistic, be honest and do not exaggerate to impress the interviewer. They are experienced enough and may trick you in their follow up questions. HR Round : ➢How was your day and how are you feeling? ➢Tell me about yourself. ➢If you compare your very first interview experience with this day, how much have you improved? ➢Tell me about your internship experience and difficulties faced ➢Has there been a situation in your life where you committed a serious mistake and didn’t admit it to avoid the consequences? ➢Why Deutsche bank? ➢Do you have any questions for me? Results were declared on the same day just after the HR round. Total 26 students were selected and I was extremely happy to be one of them! Resources for preparation : DSA : ● Strivers SDE Sheet and Strivers (455) DSA sheet (its vast but you can pick topicwise questions to make that topic strong) ● https://leetcode.com/studyplan/top-interview-150/ OS /DBMS/OOPs: ● Gate smashers playlist (OS & DBMS) ● Love Babbars roadmaps (*very helpful) (OOPs+DBMS+OS) CN: I followed my academic notes Puzzles: https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/puzzles/ System design: You may go through some famous system design questions. Some helpful resources provided by a senior: https://github.com/yash0530/InterviewPrepResources Interview Tips: ● Listen carefully to the interviewer’s questions and ask them if the question is not clear to you instead of assuming. ● Explain projects with the STAR method, and be very thorough with your projects. Go through common questions asked on projects and frameworks. Prepare for counter questions that can be asked on your projects. ● Practice explaining DSA questions while solving along with time and space complexities. Prepare answers on some famous HR questions and practice to communicate your thoughts in an effective way. Give mock interviews on interviewbit. ● Lastly, keep a pleasant smile on your face, sit comfortably and be confident.
